_comment: CRON-COMPLETIONIST-68: Jue Ming Valley Depths (决明谷深处) — the deeper cave layer beneath the surface valley. MOD-ORIGINAL: the novel does not explicitly describe layered depths of the valley; this biome is an extrapolation of the cave networks that a 'trapping formation' valley would naturally contain. CANON ANCHOR: the valley is canonically a death-zone where Wang Lin's physical body was destroyed and many cultivators perished (决明谷修士：不计其数 per 知乎专栏). The depths represent where the oldest corpses, demon-corpse mushrooms, and sealed beasts would accumulate. CLIMATE: cold (cave-modulated), no precipitation (underground), black sky/fog (no sky visible). SPAWNERS: heavier bat swarms (cave-dwelling), more skeletons (ancient fallen cultivators), no surface monsters. FEATURES: demon_corpse_mushroom (UndergroundDecoration step 7) — primary feature; spirit_vein_quartz_ore (UndergroundOres step 6). CARVERS: cave + cave_extra_underground (deeper cave networks). Referenced by spirit_bat_spawns.json biome modifier.
